name: Reaper Reaver reduces Soulstone Lure cooldown natively
contract: Reaver 807419 promises 'Reduces the cooldown of Deathstalker, Soul Shear, and Soulstone Lure by 50%'.
Its DBC effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue 11 (SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN), EffectBasePoints
Soulstone Lure (561376) has SpellFamilyName 36 and SpellFamilyFlags dword2 4, an exact match.
Player::GetSpellRecoveryTime calls ApplySpellMod(id, SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN, recovery) unconditionally for every
spell cast, so this native engine mechanism delivers the tooltip with no CoA-specific handler required.
